entities.summary: Basic Law, a significant document in the history of Macau (1987–1999). Part of Stanley Ho Era and Gambling Monopoly. Shaped Macau handover ceremony — the last European colony in Asia is returned and Macau gambling monopoly ended — licenses granted to foreign operators.
